raw:
Gallstones with acute cholecystitis are reported with a single combination code, K80.00 (calculus of gallbladder with acute cholecystitis without obstruction). The ultrasound shows gallstones and a normal common bile duct with no stone or obstruction. No separate cholecystitis or cholelithiasis codes are added. The fever, nausea, vomiting and pain are part of the condition, so they are not coded either. No external cause code applies because this is not an injury. I am not aware of any FY2027 change to this code.

["K80.00"]

The documentation supports a single code, **H90.42** (sensorineural hearing loss, unilateral, left ear, with unrestricted hearing on the contralateral side):
- The audiogram confirms sensorineural hearing loss in the left ear only.
- Right ear hearing is within normal limits, which supports "unrestricted hearing on the contralateral side."
- No external cause codes apply, since there was no noise exposure, injury or infection.
- The note lists no other conditions to code.

I don't know of any FY2027 changes to this code, but check it against the October 1, 2026 tabular.

["H90.42"]

The note describes an inflamed pinguecula of the right eye (pingueculitis). I believe a specific pingueculitis code was added in a recent update as H11.16- (right eye H11.161). I could not confirm this against the FY2027 tabular list, so check that this code exists before reporting it.

- **Pingueculitis, right eye:** H11.161. Pingueculitis is an inflamed pinguecula, so this one code covers both listed diagnoses. Adding the pinguecula code (H11.151) as well would be redundant.
- **Fallback:** If H11.161 is not in the FY2027 release, report H11.151 (pinguecula, right eye) instead.
- **External cause codes:** None apply, because the note documents no injury or external cause.

```json
["H11.161"]
```

H11.161 does not exist. Pingueculitis is classified under other conjunctivitis as H10.81-, so the right eye is **H10.811**. I believe H10.81- and pinguecula (H11.15-) exclude each other, so the separate pinguecula diagnosis is not coded. I'm recalling that exclusion rather than reading it from the FY2027 tabular. The note documents no external cause.
